_readme: Animated pins for the Pinterest automation. Files are hosted on the site and also shown on /reels/.

pins.title: Akdeinz Motion — Movement, framed with intent
pins.description: The Akdeinz Motion mark: an A and an M joined into one form, built from bands cut at 60°. Motion design studio, an East Marketing brand.
pins.alt: White Akdeinz Motion logo animating in on a black background, with the tagline Movement, framed with intent, and a blue band.

pins.title: Movement, framed with intent — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: Bands rising on a single 60° axis, the motion system behind the Akdeinz Motion identity.
pins.alt: White, grey and blue parallelogram bands rising diagonally across a black background above the words Movement, framed with intent.

pins.title: Sharp coastlines, waves, sun on water — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: Akdeniz is the Mediterranean, kept abstract and geometric. A study in 60° bands by Akdeinz Motion.
pins.alt: Rows of white and blue slanted bands rising and falling like waves on a black background.

pins.title: Move on the 60° axis — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: Bands enter and exit along their own diagonal. A motion principle of the Akdeinz Motion identity.
pins.alt: White and blue slanted bands widening and narrowing in a wave on a black background, above the words Move on the 60° axis.

pins.title: Reveal with the fold — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: Where the bands overlap, a soft fold catches the light, like film or ribbon pulled through a frame.
pins.alt: White bands sliding across a dark frame and turning light grey where they fold at an edge, above the words Reveal with the fold.

pins.title: One easing — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: Every Akdeinz Motion animation uses one curve: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1).
pins.alt: Six slanted bands sliding in one after another, holding, then sliding out, above the words One easing.

pins.title: Rises on 60° and climbs — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: A sister brand to East Marketing, same family, different direction: Akdeinz Motion rises on 60° and climbs.
pins.alt: Slanted white bars stacking upward like a staircase, the top one blue, above the words Rises on 60° and climbs.

pins.title: Flat geometry. Angled cuts. No ornament. — Akdeinz Motion
pins.description: The Akdeinz Motion identity: flat geometry, angled cuts, no gradients, no ornament.
pins.alt: Nested black and white slanted shapes moving into the frame like a tunnel, above the words Flat geometry, angled cuts, no ornament.
